prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1416; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented for evaluation following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while the patient was turning left at an intersection. The patient reports immediate onset of neck pain and stiffness, with pain radiating into the upper trapezius region and occasional headaches. Associated symptoms include limited cervical range of motion, particularly with rotation to the right, and mild paraspinal muscle tenderness on palpation. No focal neurological deficits were noted on initial examination.

Two visits have been completed to date. At the first visit, the patient was diagnosed with acute cervical strain consistent with whiplash-associated disorder and was started on a conservative plan consisting of cervical range-of-motion exercises, heat therapy, and short-term muscle relaxant use as needed. At the second visit, the patient reported partial improvement in pain and headache frequency, and range of motion was modestly improved. The treatment plan was continued, with a recommendation for a follow-up assessment and a home exercise program.

Prognosis is considered fair to good with adherence to the plan of care. Return precautions were reviewed with the patient.
